stories.title: WNBA semifinals are set: How the Valkyries beat the Wings to advance
stories.summary: Golden State overcame a 16-point deficit to eliminate Dallas and reach its first WNBA semifinals.

stories.title: 'Big shot Gabby' leads Valkyries past Wings
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 11 of her 19 points in the fourth quarter to help the Valkyries erase a 16-point second-half deficit and secure a spot in the WNBA semifinals with a 77-73 win over the Wings.

stories.title: Ohtani to play at less than 100% in playoffs, will need to 'manage' injuries
stories.summary: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani said the left knee and right biceps ailments that compromised him throughout the summer are issues he's "just going to have to manage" in the postseason.

stories.title: Pitt loses QB, upsets Virginia Tech as it seeks 'respect' in polls
stories.summary: As his Panthers improved to 5-0 on Friday night with a 35-33 victory over the Virginia Tech Hokies, Pittsburgh coach Pat Narduzzi lobbied for his unranked team, sending a message to Associated Press Top 25 voters that he has "a hell of a football team."

stories.title: Northwestern opens 'electric' Ryan Field with upset of Penn State
stories.summary: Northwestern fans, who eagerly awaited Ryan Field's opening, were rewarded with not only an easy win over a preseason Top 25 team, but a light show in the stands and waves of fireworks and flames before kickoff of the Wildcats' 34-13 win over Penn State.
